Name: Fish Fever
Author: duckbase
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52305/52305-1790081558-1738842508.png[/img]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod adds 52 brand new fish to the game. They've been added to a plethora of locations in the game, so make sure to cast your fishing rod often. This mod adds 8 legendary fish, 4 standard and 4 variants catchable during a new quest offered by Mr.Qi. All fish in this mod can be added to fish ponds, each having unique colours, the legendary fish only produce roe but the rest of them have distinct produced items. Additionally, all fish come with aquarium sprites, below are three of them.[/color][/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52305/52305-1790064316-1841107970.gif[/img]

[spoiler][list]
[*]Legendary Fish: Toggle wether or not you want to play with this mod's Legendary fish and the associated Qi quest. Make sure to not have any legendary fish in chests, your inventory or fish ponds/tanks, this will result in error items, you can still safely trash those if they show up.[/*]
[*]Saturation: Toggle between saturated and desaturated versions of the sprites.[/*]
[*]SVBO: To keep in line with Stardew Valley Balance Overhaul's modular nature, toggle between adjusted or regular prices. Changes only apply if SVBO is installed.[/*]
[*]Locations: Per location you can toggle wether or not this mod's fish are available to catch in said location. This goes for all Vanilla and Stardew Valley Expanded locations this mod touches. This is meant to make to catch certain fish if you're aiming for e.g. bundles or quests. For the mines the toggle alters catchability for all fish floors this mod touches (Floor 20 & 60 + their dangerous variants).[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
